Title: Eagle Mfg 1633 1-Drum Modular Low-Profile Spill Containment Platform (15-Gallon Sump, 2,000 lb Capacity)
Description:
The Eagle Mfg 1633 is a commercial-grade modular spill containment platform engineered for secondary containment of one 55-gallon drum. Manufactured from high-density polyethylene, this low-profile platform protects your facility and workers from hazardous leaks, drips, and spills.

Key Features:

  • Single-Drum Capacity: Sized specifically for one standard 55-gallon industrial drum.
  • 15-Gallon Sump: Reliable secondary containment capacity compliant with EPA 40 CFR 264.175 and SPCC regulations.
  • Heavy-Duty 2,000 lb Load Rating: Engineered for demanding warehouse, logistics, and manufacturing environments.
  • Low-Profile Design: Only 6-1/2 inches high for lower deck height during loading and unloading.
  • Modular Compatibility: Includes U-channel connection strip to easily link multiple platforms together.
  • Removable Grating: Durable polyethylene grating allows rapid drainage and easy cleaning.

Technical Specifications:

  • Manufacturer Part #: 1633

  • Dimensions: 26-1/4" L x 26-1/4" W x 6-1/2" H
  • Material: Chemical-resistant Polyethylene

  • Compliance Standards: EPA 40 CFR 264.175, SPCC
